sections.title: How surcharges are applied
sections.content:
## How surcharges are applied

The system only includes a surcharge that is both **Confirmed** and **valid** in:

- The total customer freight amount.
- Driver costs.
- Driver salary, where it applies.

For this reason, surcharges must be confirmed before charges are calculated so that the system uses the actual amounts.

sections.title: Accessing and selecting a document
sections.content:
### Step 1

Go to **Freight charges** > **Order charges** or **Waybill charges**.

![Freight charges menu with the order charge and waybill charge functions](/uploads/45531fa58f6bdf9aca380564.png)

### Step 2

On the charge list, select the order or waybill whose surcharges you want to update.

![Selecting an order to update surcharges for from the charge list](/uploads/cb21f11ad869307e78e21c3a.png)

Open the charge details page for the selected document.

![Order charge details page](/uploads/90e94bab55ddee1f33dfbf99.png)

sections.title: Opening the document details
sections.content:
### Step 3

If you are updating surcharges per waybill, go to the **Waybill charges** section, select the waybill you need and open its details.

![List of waybills belonging to the order](/uploads/4d5c9783cfd9e493a2fc819e.png)

![Waybill charge details opened from the order](/uploads/cb09bb5fddc8065099a69ef2.png)

### Step 4

In the **Open: Waybill charges** popup, open the related waybill.

![Opening the related waybill from the waybill charge popup](/uploads/8658c5508291690e3d06b522.png)

### Step 5

On the order or waybill details screen, scroll down to the row of business tabs.

![Document details screen before selecting a business tab](/uploads/e6f772e5082802898554e401.png)

Select the **Surcharge** tab.

![Row of business tabs including the Surcharge tab](/uploads/c5752bed95cf636af60b70a4.png)

sections.title: Confirming a surcharge
sections.content:
### Step 6

On the **Surcharge** tab, select the surcharge you want to apply, click **Confirm**, then enter the actual surcharge amount.

![Surcharges, actual amounts and the Confirm action](/uploads/79fab3b45637c649175ccc72.png)

Check the actual amount and the confirmation status of each surcharge before returning to the freight charge screen.

> **Important:** Only a surcharge that is both **confirmed** and **valid** is added to the total customer freight amount, the driver costs or the driver salary. An unconfirmed surcharge is not included in the calculation.

sections.title: Loading the data and calculating
sections.content:
Once all surcharges are confirmed, return to the freight charge screen and click **Load data** and then **Calculate** to update the result.

If the surcharges are not confirmed, the total freight amount may be incomplete, the result will not match reality, and the customer or driver costs may be wrong.
